sequence numbers in columns 1-6 with .2 suffix in identification area

purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL test suite - compiler conformance testing for intrinsic function flagging
purpose.summary: This is a NIST COBOL test suite program (IF4024.2) that tests whether a compiler correctly flags the use of high-subset intrinsic functions as non-conforming to a lower standard. It exercises 15 intrinsic functions (LENGTH, LOG, LOG10, LOWER-CASE, MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN, MIDRANGE, MIN, MOD, NUMVAL, NUMVAL-C, ORD, ORD-MAX, ORD-MIN) and expects 17 diagnostic messages total.

notable_features: NIST test suite sequence numbering with program name in identification area (columns 73-80)
Intrinsic FUNCTION usage: LENGTH, LOG, LOG10, LOWER-CASE, MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN, MIDRANGE, MIN, MOD, NUMVAL, NUMVAL-C, ORD, ORD-MAX, ORD-MIN
Multi-dimensional OCCURS table with ALL subscript
Compiler flagging test - expects NON-CONFORMING STANDARD messages
No PERFORM, CALL, or GOTO statements - purely sequential
verdict.notes: This is clearly from the NIST COBOL test suite (National Institute of Standards and Technology), used for compiler conformance testing. The .2 suffix in the filename and sequence numbers indicates a specific version of the test. All lines are exactly 80 characters (fixed format). The program tests compiler diagnostic behavior rather than runtime logic.
